_alsoRefutedAndNOTCOVEREDBYTHISREGISTER: The rule inspects BOOLEANS. Three registered NON-boolean quantities in this directory are
also refuted by the same capture and are graded by nothing at all -- stated here so a
later reader does not read this register as a clean bill of health (P-66/P-70):
interest (minor)' column carry n*E + B, i.e. the REPAYMENT figure. Measured against
the raw gz they are refuted on 3 of the 7 non-throwing cells: N3000-B3001 registered
4503001 vs observed 4503000; N3000-B4499 registered 6751499 vs observed 6750000;
* the registered outcome NAME for N103-B1, 'LAST_ROW_CARRIES_ALL_PRINCIPAL' / 'clean --
last row carries all principal', is false in its literal reading: principal lands on
ROW 14 of 103. classify_t219.py's observed label AMORTIZES_FULLY(last-row-only) means
'exactly one row carries principal', not 'the last row does', so the two strings agree
by accident of naming. Nothing in G-8 rests on WHICH row carries it -- only on WHETHER
the cell amortises, which it does -- so the region is untouched.
None of the three is a boolean, so none is inside R-VPA's remit; recording them here is a
statement about coverage, not a claim that the rule missed them.
